title: Yakima Valley Bigfoot Con Brings Sasquatch Experts to Our Studio
excerpt: Does Bigfoot really exist? We invited some Bigfoot experts into the mics to talk Sasquatch, research and Yakima Valley Bigfoot Con. Check out the full interview!
content:
The Yakima Valley Bigfoot Con shines a spotlight on Sasquatch and all the research, experts, and fans of the Pacific Northwest's favorite cryptids. A few of the experts graced our radio station studio for a fun interview before the big convention at Legends Casino Hotel Event Center. Check out the full recording below.

Do you believe in Bigfoot?

To be blunt and honest, I believe they are out there. I want them to be a type of fantastical creature that asks more questions than gives answers.

To be more paranormal or extraterrestrial in nature, instead of something that is very cunning and can elude humans all these years.

READ MORE: Idaho Hiker Reports Bigfoot Sighting Near Boise

I’d love for them to be interdimensional beings or even time travelers, but when proof that the whole world can agree with and skeptics can’t find fault with finally comes to light, no matter how their existence is explained, I will be happy and enthused!

And no matter how you feel about the topic, you’re welcome to Yakima Valley Bigfoot Con. People from all walks of life who want to learn more about these creatures attend and see, hear, and hopefully learn from the wonderful experts.

Some Of The Experts For The 2026 Yakima Valley Bigfoot Con

Lauren Smith (Night Callers Bigfoot Radio), Cliff Barackman (Discover Channel - Finding Bigfoot cast member), Ranae Holland (Discover Channel - Finding Bigfoot cast member), and Mel Skahan (researcher, filmmaker 'A Flash Of Beauty', Yakima Valley Bigfoot Con extraordinaire) were nice enough to grace the 94.5 KATS studio and chit-chat with me a little about their thoughts and Yakima Valley Bigfoot Con 2026.

Where do you stand when it comes to Bigfoot? Do you think they exist and if so, in what form and from where? Tap the App and let us know what you think.
